f2b07bbf6c593374ffb52856491b232f1f46304e.title: Reminder backend deployment (PR #1)

3c25c3564aad2af82755549d282a817934f7467f.title: Deployment build metadata fix
changes: Fixed GitHub Actions build metadata generation to use the token actually supplied by the deployment workflow.
Restored the deployment pipeline so application and browser checks can run after code changes.

9ed179e245bd03a40399380b2272a013b50d8634.title: Apply and connect verified fixes
changes: Allow pinch-to-zoom by removing the user-scalable=no viewport restriction.
Prevent episode progress from being reset when aired-episode metadata is missing or unavailable.
Make library merge timestamp ties deterministic so the existing cloud/first record wins instead of being overwritten on an equal timestamp.
Fix the editor modal height on Safari by adding a 90dvh max-height so browser toolbars do not clip the modal.
Connected the root apply_fixes.py script already on main to the GitHub Pages deployment workflow and made it safe to run repeatedly.

761f22117166b3e58ef0a8122def115c8564bba4.title: Apply the four verified fixes
changes: Allow pinch-to-zoom on mobile by removing the user-scalable=no viewport restriction.
Preserve existing episode progress when current-season release metadata is unavailable instead of reducing progress to zero.
Make mergeLibraries timestamp ties deterministic so an equal-timestamp later record cannot overwrite the first/cloud record.
Add 90dvh to the editor modal so Safari's dynamic browser toolbar does not clip the editor.
Apply these fixes to the current split source files and keep the root apply_fixes.py script connected to the deployment workflow as an idempotent verification step.
